options.description: Only re-fetch assets whose tracked ref moved  (ls-remote); reuse the rest from the existing index.

options.description: Output path for the index. Defaults to  <container>/index.lock.json.

options.description: Directory holding local asset checkouts (local  source). Defaults to the container's parent.
